purpose: Phase-1 control for maximizing scheduled-Chat contribution alongside the unchanged authoritative primary O Work execution. Chat workers must execute every safely Chat-capable step and may hand off only actions proven irreducibly Work-exclusive or protected-primary-writer-only.
authoritative_for: portfolio membership/allocation, method optimization, scheduler reconciliation, Chat-capability/irreducible-handoff matrix and Phase-1 root acceptance; role configs remain substantive role authority
supersedes: O_CHAT_PARALLEL control8 only where control8 incorrectly required elimination of every Work/protected-primary execution step and made zero monthly quota/zero incremental cost hard closure gates. All other control8 safety, pool, CLEAN, evidence, anti-stop, scheduler and Phase-2 rules remain in force.

non_regression.rule: Preserve the entire control8 baseline as restoration/safety state: all 19 intended roles active, CLEAN isolation, role-local continuation/recovery, checkpoint/resume, exact scope/provenance, conflict/claim discipline, no primary lease/fence/frozen-request/protected-state mutation, no direct main merge, no worker self-disable, no optimizer pool reduction, repository control authority, physical-scheduler separation, and immediate Phase-2 portfolio transition on accepted Phase-1 closure. This revision changes only the Phase-1 objective/acceptance semantics to match the current user contract.

phase.name: phase_1_chat_parity
phase.root_problem: Make the existing scheduled Chat-mode pool contribute as effectively as possible alongside the unchanged authoritative primary Work execution: reconstruct latest role-relevant state safely, select non-conflicting work, execute every available Chat-capable step, persist durable evidence/continuation, avoid duplicate/conflicting effects, and hand off only the minimal action that is proven irreducibly Work-exclusive or protected-primary-writer-only.
phase.authority_rule: Never duplicate primary authority. A protected-primary/Work action may remain only as a minimal verified handoff after all predecessor work that is safely executable in scheduled Chat has been completed. A handoff is invalid if the same effect can be safely completed with actually exposed Chat capabilities or if irreducibility is unsupported.
phase.acceptance_criterion: All 19 intended roles are active and assignment-bound; each role can reconstruct current role-relevant state, receive repository-controlled allocation, execute all safely Chat-capable work for its selected leaf, persist evidence/continuation, avoid duplication/conflict, and either finish the effect in Chat or produce a unique minimal handoff independently verified as irreducibly Work-exclusive or protected-primary-writer-only. Integrator and optimizer independently confirm the full matrix and aggregate gates.
phase.on_acceptance: Persist Phase-1 completion evidence, preserve all base/restoration continuations as fallback metadata, clear Phase-1-specific assignments, immediately compute the full-pool Phase-2 portfolio minimizing expected elapsed time to the unchanged primary O objective, assign every managed role to its highest-value non-conflicting Chat-capable work, and enter Phase 2 with no blanket restoration interval.

allowed_classes: action requires the authoritative primary Work lease/fence or consumption of its frozen request
action writes protected primary execution state reserved to the authoritative primary
action requires primary merge authority or another repository-defined primary-writer-only effect
action is Work-exclusive because the required capability is not actually exposed in scheduled Chat and no safe Chat-capable route can produce the same effect
preconditions: all safely Chat-capable predecessor and preparation work for the leaf has been executed
current exposed Chat capabilities were checked rather than assumed absent
direct Chat solution and existing-solution audit were attempted before declaring irreducibility
irreducibility is supported by durable capability/authority evidence, not merely by a prior prompt or worker assertion
handoff payload is the minimum exact effect needed and identifies the authority boundary without asking the parallel worker to cross it
handoff has an idempotent identity or other duplicate-effect guard and does not conflict with an active claim
irreducible_handoff_contract.invalid_handoff: Any unsupported, convenience, quota-only, generic 'needs Work', or otherwise reducible handoff keeps the leaf and ancestors unresolved.
irreducible_handoff_contract.user_action_rule: Manual user execution is not a substitute for a missing Chat capability. If genuinely user-only authorization/input is required, record it as a user blocker; it is not an accepted Work/primary-writer handoff.
irreducible_handoff_contract.clean_boundary: CLEAN explorers may record only generic capability/authority limits learned from their own allowed inputs. O-specific/protected-primary semantics and final irreducibility classification belong to downstream verification/integration and must never be leaked back to CLEAN roles.

resource_policy.rule: Use only capabilities actually available in the current scheduled Chat environment. Prefer zero-cost, quota-independent, rate-limit-tolerant routes when they reduce expected time or failure risk, but quota/cost are optimization and availability attributes rather than independent Phase-1 closure gates unless the feature is unavailable now or requires unauthorized spending.
resource_policy.unavailable_now: A route depending on a currently unavailable/exhausted capability is not executable evidence; checkpoint the exact blocker and search/reassign to another Chat-capable route.
resource_policy.repository_transport: Lightweight repository APIs may transport state/evidence and must be used with checkpoint/backoff/CAS/readback rather than as simulated hosted compute.
resource_policy.rate_limit_test: Where a route relies on repository transport, preserve evidence that invocation boundaries or rate limits can be checkpointed and resumed without duplicate effects.

chat_authority_transport.fallback: inherit control8 exact-blob two-pass/ABA/CAS/readback fallback unchanged

intended_pool.selection_rule: Use all 19 intended existing roles. Do not disable, pause, delete, replace or reduce the pool. Complete/blocked/duplicate/low-value roles are immediately reassigned to another non-conflicting Phase-1 leaf. work_delegation_gate remains standby only because the intended roles plus protected monitor occupy the active-task capacity and its bounded fallback remains optimizer-owned.

method_optimization.source: complete J-style recursive problem-solving loop adapted to scheduled Chat; J AGI objective excluded
required: forecast problem tree/ETA; audit unresolved leaves and unaudited ancestors for existing Chat solutions before decomposition
attempt direct Chat solution first; decompose only when child integration can solve the parent
integrate evidence upward; on forecast overrun/assumption failure compare transversal and alternative plans and switch only if expected time-to-root improves
optimize representation, method, verification, worker combination, concurrency, integration path and switching threshold
at a protected-primary/Work boundary complete all Chat-capable preparation, minimize the remainder, and independently verify irreducibility; never duplicate primary authority
preserve replaced-branch evidence; separate observation/inference/unverified claims; fail closed

phase_1_plan.direct_attempt: Inventory material outcomes and prove the smallest safe Chat contribution path for each outcome family before adding research branches. For every remaining non-Chat action, minimize and verify the irreducible boundary.
phase_1_plan.row_status_rule: A row is solved when all safely Chat-capable work is durably completed and either no remaining action exists or every remaining action is independently verified as a unique minimal irreducible Work-exclusive/protected-primary-writer handoff. Unsupported or reducible handoffs fail closed.
phase_1_plan.overrun_trigger: Any intended role disabled after one reconciliation opportunity; no assignment-bound evidence after two enabled invocations; no substantive progress twice; matrix/checker controls disagree; repeated unsupported/reducible handoffs; repeated attempts to erase a verified protected-primary-writer boundary; or measured critical path materially exceeds forecast.
phase_1_plan.overrun_action: Generate and compare alternative transport, architecture, method, decomposition, verification and allocation plans; use transversal redesign to eliminate reducible dependency families and minimize genuinely irreducible boundaries; switch only when expected completion time improves.

per_role_required: current assignment bound through authoritative note control
all safely Chat-capable work for the selected leaf executed
durable source-qualified evidence and exact continuation persisted
any remaining Work/protected-primary action represented only as a minimal independently verifiable irreducible handoff
no unsupported or reducible handoff accepted
quality_metrics_not_independent_closure_: rate-limit resilience beyond what is necessary for the actually selected Chat route
negative_controls: A handoff for an action that the current scheduled Chat role can safely complete must fail.
A generic or unsupported 'needs Work' handoff must fail.
A duplicate handoff for an already claimed or completed logical effect must fail.
A worker crossing the protected-primary authority boundary must fail.
A low-usefulness trace below the current useful-output threshold must fail.
acceptance.positive_control: A trace may pass with a nonempty remaining-action set only when all predecessor Chat-capable work is complete and each remaining action is independently evidenced as unique, minimal and irreducibly Work-exclusive or protected-primary-writer-only, with no user-execution substitution.

coordinators.integrator: maintains the 19-cell acceptance matrix, recursive problem tree and Chat-contribution/irreducible-handoff matrix while preserving existing index/feed safety
coordinators.automation_optimizer: independently rederives role cells, allocation, handoff irreducibility/uniqueness, conflict/authority/usefulness gates and physical reconciliation; never becomes primary writer
coordinators.evidence_comparator: independently recomputes handoff irreducibility, reducibility, duplication, conflict, authority and usefulness gates
coordinators.bridge: attempts direct Chat replacement first, then minimizes and packages only verified irreducible Work/protected-primary-writer effects without executing them

acceptance.closure_rule: Missing, stale, bootstrap-invalid, mirror-only or unsupported evidence is not a pass. Phase 1 remains open while any safely Chat-capable step is undone, any handoff is unsupported/reducible/duplicated, any protected authority is violated, any intended role lacks evidence, or aggregate gates fail. A verified minimal irreducible Work-exclusive/protected-primary-writer handoff is permitted by the user acceptance criterion and does not by itself keep Phase 1 open.

base_restoration: Preserve every original role, exact continuation, anti-stop/recovery, CLEAN boundary, provenance and CAS/readback contract as fallback metadata. During Phase 1 no role returns to unrelated base work. After Phase 1 base work is only a candidate in the Phase-2 optimum.

optimizer.phase_1_goal: Minimize expected elapsed time until the full existing pool has demonstrated durable scheduled-Chat contribution parity: every Chat-capable step completed and only verified minimal irreducible Work/protected-primary-writer actions handed off.
optimizer.phase_2_goal: After Phase 1, minimize expected elapsed time to the unchanged primary O objective using the full then-enabled pool.
optimizer.next_action: Synchronize DESIRED_STATE and DOWNSTREAM_STATE to control9; invalidate control8 zero-residual-step closure oracles for current acceptance while preserving their historical evidence; re-run evaluation/evidence/integration against reducible-versus-irreducible handoff controls and independently rederive 19/19 closure.

migration.reason: Control8 over-constrained Phase 1 by making every residual Work/protected-primary action and quota/cost attribute an independent closure failure. The current user contract instead requires scheduled Chat to do all work it can and to hand off only actions that are truly irreducible Work-exclusive or protected-primary-writer-only. Control9 restores that distinction without weakening the primary safety boundary or the full-pool/anti-stop/CLEAN contracts.
migration.preserve_prior_evidence: Artifacts produced under root v4 remain durable historical evidence. They cannot establish current Phase-1 acceptance unless reclassified under the v5 irreducible-handoff contract; no semantic findings are discarded.
migration.rollback_condition: Only independently proven authority, CLEAN-isolation, conflict, protected-primary safety, evidence-integrity, or worker-baseline regression. Never rollback merely to restore the control8 blanket prohibition on verified irreducible handoffs.
